coder_notes: Observational-type biomarker study (registered phase NA) with only a plasma-collection intervention. Bevacizumab is the clinical treatment of the enrolled patients, listed for transparency as background; it is an established GBM therapy and not the subject of investigation. CD146 is a predictive plasma marker, not a pharmacodynamic marker of a candidate, so target_engagement is unclear.
